title: Fruits Into Baskets II
description:
You are given two arrays of size n:

fruits[i] → quantity of fruit type i
baskets[j] → capacity of basket j
Rules

Process fruits from left to right:

For each fruit, find the leftmost unused basket such that:
basket capacity ≥ fruit quantity
Each basket can be used only once
If no basket can hold a fruit → it remains unplaced
Task

Return the number of unplaced fruits

Examples

Example 1

fruits = [4,2,5]
baskets = [3,5,4]
→ 1

Example 2

fruits = [3,6,1]
baskets = [6,4,7]
→ 0
Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 100
1 ≤ fruits[i], baskets[i] ≤ 1000
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
